movement: A.4 closes the uniform balanced degree-two mixed-product gate over every ordinary modulus. The proof was promoted at15:53:01UTC, after actual review11 at15:51:59.733641UTC, and therefore first counts in this review. Its exact group is Hom(F2²,F2^32) semidirect GL32(F2), with geometric and arithmetic images equal. The still-open balanced fixed-modulus gate now begins at degree3.

A.4 also has exact uniform mixed-product groups for every strip of factor degrees(3,b), b>=3: GL_(3b-1)(F2) for oddb and the full one-trace-covector stabilizer F2^(3b-2) semidirect GL_(3b-2)(F2) for evenb. This closes these previously undecided polarization cases; it does not settle balanced degrees>=3.

B.4 strictly excludes comparisons of two potentially CM formal models from the remaining p² ambiguity at p>=5,e=p-1,height2. The exact least manuscript index in that subclass is1, with a proved lower pair and full first-wild-layer recovery. At least one model in any remaining unrestricted ambiguity must be non-CM.

B.4 strictly shrinks the irreducible-residual branch: unequal normalized types must have maximal joint tame degree p²-1 and be adjacent in the explicitly proved cycle of length(p+1)/2. In particular opposite quadratic-twist pairs are excluded for p congruent3 mod4,p>=7. No new p5 exclusion or realization is asserted. The reducible-residual branch remains separately open.
